ticket: Savar's ask of 2026-11-05: design the batch and one-page flows of Scan pages (spec #368; slices S3, S4, S5, S8, S9)
route: design skill, focused route, explore stage. job_kind new, surface product, constraint_mode existing-system. Mockups only: no product code changes.

picked.start_screen: A's start screen and live camera with auto-take, plus Choose photos and the phone's camera (B's fallback) on the same screen
picked.stack: B's stack. In this round A and B render the same stack screen: it is the parent's home when pages are waiting, and its camera button opens Add pages (Start scanning, Choose photos, Use my phone's camera)
picked.other: Savar accepted the recommendations in open_decisions_for_savar
picked.build_order: The shared stack on the current file input, then the real-phone camera test, then the live camera

how_to_open: From the repo root: python3 -m http.server 3565 --directory .design/experiments/r565, then open http://127.0.0.1:3565/. Everything is local. Each state has its own address, such as a.html#stack.
decision: Where does the parent stay between two photos, so that 10 to 20 pages in a sitting are comfortable with one hand?
primary_axis: the home of the capture loop: in the camera, on the stack, or on the day's list of pages
evidence: Taps per page, whether guidance can reach the parent while the page is in front of the camera, what happens when a check refuses a page the parent has already turned, and what the browser can really do on a phone
invariants: Same sample child (Leah, the sample child in DESIGN.md), same pages, same tokens (warm look) and dashboard frame (r544 set 2 option A)
Each photo uploads and saves as soon as it is taken, so a closed tab loses nothing, and there is no per-page confirm
Same refusal words, Send button, marking, marks ready, Please check and Change this mark screens in every option
Flow B is the same surface with one page in the stack: no choice of mode
Copy names the child, never she or her; no provider names; no claims about speed or accuracy; no total score across pages (D-243)

sources.current_screens: src/components/scan-pages.tsx (S1), scan-preview.tsx (S2b), the Scan pages tab (r564), the frame in parent-shell.css

options.name: Camera stays open
options.bet: The parent stays in a live camera in the page. It reads each page's QR code and four corners, takes the photo with no tap when the page is new and still, and shows a pile. Turn the page, and it goes on.
options.benefit: No tap per page. Guidance arrives while the page is in front of the camera. It cannot take the same page twice, and it does not photograph a wrong or marked page.
options.cost: Needs camera permission and a browser camera build. A late refusal asks the parent to turn back, or waits to the end.
options.risk: Unproven: a video frame may read worse than a real photo. Nobody has tested this on a real phone (#454, G13).
options.taps_for_20_pages: about 2 with auto (Start, Done); about 22 with the shutter

options.name: Stack first
options.bet: The stack is home. Each photo uses the phone's own camera (what S1 already does), then returns to the stack.
options.benefit: Works today on every phone. Best photo quality. No permission. Also allows choosing many photos from the phone's library.
options.cost: We cannot draw on the phone's camera, so no guidance until after the photo. Every refusal arrives after the page is turned.
options.risk: About 3 taps a page, 60 for 20 pages. Parents may stop part way. A phone short of memory can reload the page when its camera returns.
options.taps_for_20_pages: about 60 (Take a photo, shutter, Use Photo)

options.name: Day checklist
options.bet: The day's printed pages are the home: 8 slots a day, filled as photos arrive. The parent sees at once what has no photo.
options.benefit: Matches how days work (D-213). Gaps are obvious, and that matters for the Day 7 snapshot. The printed page shows what to photograph.
options.cost: One tap per page, and a day switch every 8 pages. Pages out of order need more thought.
options.risk: Empty slots can read as a list of things the child did not do. It needs the live camera too, so it has A's risk with fewer of A's benefits.
options.taps_for_20_pages: about 22 (a tap per page, day switches, and the camera still has to be live)

taps_note: Taps are counted along the mock's path. They are estimates, not a timed test with a parent.
recommendation: A, with two parts of the others: B's phone camera as the fallback when the browser refuses or the camera test fails, and C's 'No photo yet: page 2' line in the stack. Build the shared stack on the current file input first, because that path is already built and ships without A's risk. Then run the real-phone camera test, then add A.
findings_from_the_round: A book opens as two pages, and calibration refuses two sheets (D-252). So every option has to teach 'fold the book back'. The tip, the live message and the refusal all say it.

The current limit of 20 photos per 10 minutes is exactly the size of the sitting Savar asks for, and retakes count. A 20-page sitting with one retake gets refused. 2 uploads at once also means the browser must queue photos in a fast loop.
Checks finish after the page is turned, so a refusal must not interrupt. The stack puts refused pages first; the camera shows a quiet message with 'Take it again now'.
A retake cannot change a finalized mark (#457). So a photo of a marked page says: 'A new photo does not change the marks', and points to Change this mark.
A pending Please check means the page is not complete (#457), so its row says 'Please check 1', not a score.

The page's QR code, read by the phone's normal camera, opens the desk link (/tutor/p/<token>), not Scan pages. A parent can do this by mistake. That screen may need a 'Scan this page' link. Not in this round.
Public copy (DESIGN.md How it works step 5, For parents) still says 'the Unica app', though D-193 made scanning part of the web app.

open_decisions_for_savar.q: Pick the option or a mix
open_decisions_for_savar.recommend: A with B's fallback and C's gap line, in the build order above
open_decisions_for_savar.answer: A's start screen and live camera, Choose photos and the phone's camera on the same screen, B's stack (D-269)

open_decisions_for_savar.q: Auto-take on by default, or shutter only?
open_decisions_for_savar.recommend: Auto on, with a switch at the top right. It is the only way the other hand stays on the book
open_decisions_for_savar.answer: Yes: on by default, with a switch (D-269)

open_decisions_for_savar.q: Can Send go while some pages are refused or still being checked?
open_decisions_for_savar.recommend: Yes. Send what is ready; the others stay in the stack. Your ask reads 'send them all', so this needs your word
open_decisions_for_savar.answer: Yes: those pages stay in the stack (D-270)

open_decisions_for_savar.recommend: Yes: 40 photos per 10 minutes, keep 60 a day, and queue in the browser. Needs a small migration
open_decisions_for_savar.answer: Yes: 40 per 10 minutes, 60 a day stays (D-271)

open_decisions_for_savar.q: Tell the parent when marks are ready?
open_decisions_for_savar.recommend: One email per send, only when the parent left the page. Not in the spec, and the mock promises nothing beyond 'the marks show here'
open_decisions_for_savar.answer: Yes: one per send, only when the parent left the page (D-272)

open_decisions_for_savar.q: Shorter child row on Scan pages for phones (one line, with Open the desk as a link)?
open_decisions_for_savar.recommend: Yes. The full block takes about 180 px above the stack. It is an exception to the r544 frame

open_decisions_for_savar.q: Desktop: show the phone's pages live beside the QR code, with Send there too?
open_decisions_for_savar.recommend: Yes. It extends D-246. Retakes stay on the phone

open_decisions_for_savar.q: Allow two facing pages in one photo later?
open_decisions_for_savar.recommend: Not now. It would halve the photos, but D-252 refuses two sheets to protect the crops

Targets on the picked screens: every link and button is 44 px or more, measured on 24 states at 390, 768 and 1440 px (picked.html). The picked mock uses 44 px for the sidebar tabs; parent-shell.css has 40 px, so the build changes that. Options A, B and C keep their shots from before this fix
browser: Aside, account u0, viewport resizing. The mockups are static pages, so the desktop user agent does not change them. Bars are fixed to the viewport; a whole-page shot sets the viewport to the page height.

build_notes: The page's QR code, read by the phone's normal camera, opens the desk link (/tutor/p/<token>), not Scan pages. The build must route it, so a parent who scans a page that way can reach Scan pages.

Public copy still says 'the Unica app', though D-193 made scanning part of the web app: src/components/how-it-works.tsx, how-demos.tsx, whats-included.tsx, whats-included-scan.tsx, whats-included-dash.tsx, src/app/(site)/whats-included/page.tsx, src/lib/faq.ts, src/lib/parent.ts, src/lib/ai-summary.ts, and DESIGN.md (How it works step 5, For parents, Companion app).
Choose photos uses a file input with multiple and no capture. The current input has capture='environment', which forces the camera; Use my phone's camera keeps it.
The browser queues uploads, 2 at once (concurrent_uploads). The limit change needs a migration, and the current client refuses a busy upload.
The email needs a new kind and a way to know that the parent left the page. It carries no child work, as the other parent emails do.
